On December 30, 2023, ICICI Bank Limited (the Bank) had disclosed an Order in Original 
(OIO) received from the Telangana Goods and Services Tax department for a penalty of 
₹ 13,55,750/-. 
 
Pursuant to an appeal filed by it on the OIO, the Bank has, on October 31, 2026 at 
4:45 p.m., received an Order in Appeal (OIA) under Section 107 of Central Goods and 
Services Tax Act, 2017 from the Additional Commissioner, (ST) (Grade-I) (FAC), 
Telangana, confirming a penalty of ₹ 6,95,418/-. 
 
The Bank will file an appeal contesting the OIA within the prescribed timelines. 
 
Please take the above information on record.
